_comment: Directus API Manager - Entity Generator Options
_comment2: Copy this file as 'directus_api_manager_options.json' and fill in your values.
_comment_auth: Authentication: use either a static_token OR email+password
_comment_auth_alt: Alternative: use email and password instead of static_token
_comment_output: Relative path from project root where generated files will be written. Created automatically if it does not exist.
_comment_suffix: Suffix appended to each generated class name. Example: 'player' collection -> 'PlayerDirectusModel'
_comment_exclude: List of collection names to exclude from generation. System collections (directus_*) are always excluded.
_comment_collections: Per-collection options to customize the generated @CollectionMetadata annotation. Only add entries for collections that need non-default values. All fields are optional.

example_collection._comment: defaultFields: fields to fetch by default (default: "*")
example_collection._comment2: webSocketEndPoint: custom WebSocket endpoint name (default: null, uses collection name)
example_collection._comment3: defaultUpdateFields: fields to return after an update (default: null)
